subphases.name: Admit full independent reference job census
subphases.requirement: Enumerate all five families times240 cases times5 windows times5 arms and all expected query IDs before any execution. Required jobs exist regardless of candidate mode, calls, success or abstention. Only training labels are admitted; held target bank remains unavailable.

subphases.name: Execute reference fitting or explicit no-fit preparation
subphases.requirement: Actually execute R0/R1/R2 fixed training under the unchanged bank/algebra. R4 emits an explicit constant-recipe state with no learned parameters; R5 computes its permitted training-label counts/prior. Record their real preparation rather than claiming artificial model fits. All original completion, outputs, failures and costs observed independently.

subphases.name: Seal independently observed reference state
subphases.requirement: Bind reference source/config/environment, preparation kind, eligible training membership/features/labels, serialized state and original terminal observations. Seal before query input is admitted. Missing output or completion produces no valid seal.

subphases.name: Admit exact permitted reference queries
subphases.requirement: Serve only the same allowed family values and query support as the corresponding candidate arm. No held labels, other-fold information, source IDs, query-dependent fitting or source workspace. R4/R5 legitimately ignore feature values but still bind every served query identity/support.

subphases.name: Execute original trusted reference inference
subphases.requirement: Actually invoke the sealed fixed reference prediction procedure for every admitted original inference job, producing 27 finite independent probabilities for each query. Bind original source/state/query and exact probability bytes; independently observe launch, completion, streams and resources. Neither a training seal nor candidate tool-call receipt is a reference prediction.

subphases.name: Materialize identity-qualified logical reference outputs
subphases.requirement: Only proved same-input pure-reference outputs may be reused. Emit separately bound logical destinations, including current opaque IDs and class order, from actual original probability bytes. Record source/destination query mapping, exact numeric payload identity and independent allowed-information proof; label/window aliases or candidate calls alone never authorize reuse.

subphases.name: Collect and verify complete independent case artifacts
subphases.requirement: Every one of30,000 family/case/window/arm artifacts has all expected opaque query IDs exactly once and exactly27 bounded probabilities per row. Bind source/config/environment/training seal/query/probability/receipt identities. Reject missing, extra, malformed or receiptless outputs; no withheld reference family, abstention or chosen support subset.

subphases.name: Seal full independent reference bank and original resource closure
subphases.requirement: Freeze all actual output bytes and original preparation/inference/materialization/collection observations. Supply the complete bank to S14/A07 and every original resource/failure record to S19; never supply training seals in place of predictions. Expose only a separately access-controlled NUM_REF tool handle, not the bank directory. The external observer records this final bank-seal process completion and exact output identities; the bank cannot certify its own original completion.
